working_features: Server starts on configurable port and logs incoming requests
GET /items returns JSON array of all items
GET /items/{id} returns a single item by ID or 404 if not found
POST /items creates a new item from JSON body and returns 201 with created item
PUT /items/{id} updates existing item and returns updated item or 404
DELETE /items/{id} deletes item and returns 204 or 404 if not found
All responses include correct Content-Type: application/json header
Invalid JSON in request bodies returns 400 Bad Request with error message
Unsupported routes return 404 Not Found
Unsupported methods on valid routes return 405 Method Not Allowed with Allow header
Basic token authentication via Authorization header returns 401 for invalid/missing token
Items are stored in a JSON file and loaded on startup
GET /items supports query parameter filtering by any field
Server handles concurrent requests using threading
